LIBSCRIPT_VOLUME_NAME.description: Logical storage volume name for persistent data mounts.

LIBSCRIPT_VOLUME_SIZE.description: Size of the volume in GB.

LIBSCRIPT_VOLUME_TYPE.description: Type of the volume (e.g., ssd, hdd).

LIBSCRIPT_NODE_ID.description: Node ID to attach/detach the volume.

LIBSCRIPT_VOLUME_ID.description: Volume ID for operations like delete, attach, detach.

LIBSCRIPT_AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP.description: Azure Resource Group hosting managed disks when LIBSCRIPT_CLOUD='azure'.
